TransportOptions.summary: Transport-specific options for a `@transport` configuration. What keys mean varies by transport (`kind`).
TransportOptions.authors: Optional bag of extras for the chosen transport. See that transport's docs for which keys it accepts.
TransportOptions.implementers: Forward as the `options` field on the transport configuration. Do not invent new top-level `@transport` args for transport-specific settings.

_HoistConfig.summary: Serialized hoist path (string list and/or `{ fieldName, filterArgs }` objects) describing how a nested field was lifted.
_HoistConfig.authors: Usually emitted by the hoist transform, not hand-written.
_HoistConfig.implementers: Preserve through composition so Gateway / Connectors selection rewrites can re-apply the path. Treat as structured JSON, not free text.

ResolveToSourceArgs.summary: Map of argument name -> value expression (often with `{root...}` / `{args...}` interpolation) forwarded when delegating to a source field.
ResolveToSourceArgs.authors: Use object syntax in SDL: `sourceArgs: { id: "{root.id}" }`.
ResolveToSourceArgs.implementers: Parse as a string-keyed map. Interpolate with the same resolver-data rules as other additional-field binders before calling the source field.

@transport.summary: Declares how the gateway reaches a subgraph: kind, location, optional headers, and `options`. Repeatable on SCHEMA so one schema document can describe multiple subgraphs.

authors.intro: Every non-Connectors subgraph should carry `@transport`. Pair protocol field directives (`@sql`, `@mongo__*`, ...) with a matching `kind`. Do not use this for HTTP/REST Connectors `@source(http:)` - that lives under specs.apollo.dev/connect.

implementers.intro: Each `@transport` application is transport configuration: which subgraph, which transport (`kind`), where to connect (`location`), optional default `headers`, and optional transport-specific `options` (keys vary by transport). The directive contract is fully described here.
implementers.compose: Schemas emit `@link(url: "https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/core/v0.1", import: ["@transport"])` and apply `@transport` on the schema. Composition may rewrite or drop pure-http transports that duplicate `join__graph` URLs, or rewrite non-http transports into `join__directive` for Apollo-safe Supergraph printing while keeping a reconstitutable definition.
implementers.loaders: Always include `subgraph` + `kind`. Put transport-specific settings in `options`, not new top-level args.
implementers.runtime: Build a map of transport configurations from SCHEMA apps. Reject unsupported `@link` versions for this family. Executors select by `kind`, then use `location` / `headers` / `options`.
implementers.validation:
Requires: `@transport` is SCHEMA-only (reject apps on types/fields). `kind` is required and must be a non-empty string. When present: `subgraph` and `location` must be strings; `options` must be an object (not an array); `headers` must be an array of `[name, value]` pairs.

@link: Mesh family `@link` URLs under `https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/` must use a supported version (`v0.1`). Unrecognized Mesh family versions are rejected. If any core Mesh directives are used on the schema, a supported `core` `@link` must be present (legacy `https://the-guild.dev/graphql/mesh/spec/...` core links remain accepted when reading).

subgraph.constraints: Non-empty. Must be the same subgraph name used for this source in composition (unique among composed subgraphs).
subgraph.authors: Name of the subgraph this entry configures - the same identifier used for that source everywhere in composition.
subgraph.implementers: Key this `@transport` configuration with the composition subgraph name; match protocol directive `subgraph:` args to the same string.
subgraph.validation: When present must be a string; for ordinary Mesh transports it should be non-empty and match the composition subgraph name.

kind.authors: Selects which transport implementation the gateway runs.
kind.implementers: Dispatch table key. Transport-specific variants belong in `options`, not in `kind`.

location.constraints: URI / DSN / endpoint string understood by that kind (Postgres URL, Mongo URI, Thrift HTTP endpoint, ...).
location.authors: Where to connect. May be omitted when the runtime injects the endpoint.
location.implementers: May be dropped from the printed Supergraph when it duplicates `join__graph(url:)` for pure HTTP. Still required at execution unless overridden by runtime configuration.
location.validation: When present must be a string.

headers.constraints: List of `[name, value]` pairs (a map may be normalized to pairs). Values may include interpolations depending on the transport.
headers.authors: Default HTTP (or transport) headers sent with upstream calls for this subgraph.
headers.implementers: Keep these as the default headers for this transport. Merge with per-request headers the way that transport expects - do not drop headers the transport treats as security-sensitive.
headers.validation: When present must be an array (list of pairs).

options.authors: Extra options for that transport. They are not shared across transports; check the transport you use.
options.implementers: Attach as this configuration's `options`. Leave interpretation to the transport for that `kind`.
options.validation: When present must be an object, not an array or scalar.

@source.summary: Composition provenance: records the original subgraph type/field name when renames occur. Not Connectors `@source(http:)` from specs.apollo.dev/connect.

authors.intro: Usually stamped by Compose when types/fields are renamed. When Connectors `@source` is also present, Mesh may alias this as `@meshSource` via `@link(as:)`.

implementers.compose: Emit on renamed elements; keep `subgraph` aligned with transport configurations. Alias to `@meshSource` if Apollo Connectors `@source` shares the schema.
implementers.runtime: Use to recover original names for executor selection / error coordinates. Ignore Connectors `http:` shape - different directive.
implementers.validation: Require `name` and `subgraph` as non-empty strings for Mesh stitching provenance apps (args shaped with `subgraph:`, not Connectors `http:`).

name.constraints: Original type or field name in the source subgraph.
name.implementers: Lookup key for reverse rename / coordinate mapping.

type.constraints: Original GraphQL type string when field types were rewritten.
type.authors: Rarely hand-set; Compose fills when needed.
type.implementers: Restore printed types when projecting back to the subgraph schema.

subgraph.constraints: Owning subgraph name - the same identifier used for that source in composition (and on `@transport(subgraph:)` when present).
subgraph.authors: Which composed subgraph owned the original name. Use the same subgraph name as elsewhere for that source.
subgraph.implementers: Scope provenance per composition subgraph name; repeatable apps accumulate across sources.

@merge.summary: Marks a Query (or other) field as a type-merging entry point: the gateway uses it to fill an entity by key, including batched list lookups.

authors.intro:
Put `@merge` on a field that can resolve an entity (or a list of entities) from keys. Mesh keeps `@merge` supported for stitching-style type merging.

Single-object entity resolution: prefer Federation Spec `@lookup` / `@is` / `@internal` (https://graphql.github.io/graphql-federation-spec/draft) when you are modeling federation entity recall for one object.

List / batch: use `@merge` when the entry point returns a list and should batch many keys in one call (`keyField` + `keyArg`, or `argsExpr` with a list expansion). That is the author-facing Mesh path for N+1-safe type merging across subgraphs.

implementers.intro:
Type-merging entry point. When planning entity fills, map keys to this field's arguments and invoke it (single or batched). Supported and first-class on this family - not a deprecated alias.

Single-object federation recall may instead use Federation `@lookup` when that contract applies. List-returning `@merge` fields must accept a key list (via `keyArg` or `argsExpr` expansion) so the runtime can batch.
implementers.compose: Schemas `@link` this family and import `@merge`. Preserve apps through Supergraph printing (or rewrite into `join__directive` when required) so runtime can rebuild merge config. `subgraph`, when present, must match the composition subgraph name.
implementers.runtime: Register the annotated field as a merged-type entry point: extract keys from origin objects (`keyField` / `key` / selection), pass them through `keyArg` or `argsExpr`, call the field, and map results back onto waiting objects. For list return types, batch keys into one call when `keyArg`/`argsExpr` accepts a list.
implementers.validation: FIELD_DEFINITION only (as published). Reject combining `argsExpr` with `keyArg`/`additionalArgs`. List-returning fields that use `argsExpr` must use a list expansion. `subgraph`, when present, must match a composition subgraph name.

subgraph.constraints: Composition subgraph name for this merge entry point.
subgraph.authors: Name which composed subgraph owns this merge field. Use the same subgraph name elsewhere for that source.
subgraph.implementers: Attribute the merge entry to that composition subgraph name.

keyField.constraints: Dotted field path on the origin object used as the merge key (e.g. `id`, `organization.id`).
keyField.authors: Which parent/origin field provides the key value for this merge.
keyField.implementers: Read this path from each origin object to build keys (and selection sets).

keyArg.defaults: Optional when the field has a single argument or `argsExpr` is set.
keyArg.constraints: Argument name (possibly dotted) that receives the merge key or key list.
keyArg.authors: For batch/list merges, name the list argument that receives collected keys (e.g. `ids`).
keyArg.implementers: Pass collected keys into this argument; required when the field has more than one argument and `argsExpr` is absent.

key.constraints: Explicit key field names when not using `keyField`.
key.authors: Alternate to `keyField` for declaring which fields form the object key.
key.implementers: Build the key expression from these field names when `keyField` is omitted.

argsExpr.constraints: Expression mapping `$key` into field arguments. List-returning fields need a list expansion (`[[...]]`).
argsExpr.authors: Advanced key->args mapping when a single `keyArg` is not enough.
argsExpr.implementers: Parse and apply as merge args expression; validate expansion rules for list vs singleton return types.

additionalArgs.constraints: Extra static/argument expression string merged into the call.
additionalArgs.authors: Rare; prefer `keyArg` + field args for ordinary batch merges.
additionalArgs.implementers: Merge into the delegated args when `argsExpr` is not used.

@resolveTo.summary: Binds a Supergraph field to another source field, a batched key lookup, and/or a PubSub topic (webhooks / subscriptions). The gateway resolves the annotated field by routing from that field to the configured target.

authors.intro:
Put `@resolveTo` on the Supergraph field the client selects (from). The gateway does not run a hand-written resolver for that field; it routes to a target (to) described by the args.

Source delegation (from -> to): `sourceName` picks the subgraph; `sourceTypeName` + `sourceFieldName` name the field on that subgraph's schema (e.g. `Query.repositoriesByUserId`). The gateway builds a delegated operation to that field. `requiredSelectionSet` guarantees parent fields needed before the hop (often keys used in `sourceArgs`). `sourceArgs` maps parent / field args into the target field's arguments (`{root.*}`, `{args.*}`). Optional `sourceSelectionSet` shapes what is requested under the target field; `result` / `resultType` project the return value.

Batch path: With `keyField` + `keysArg`, many parent objects share one call: keys come from each parent's `keyField`, are passed as the target's list argument named by `keysArg`, and (when set) `valueKeyField` rematches unordered results. `additionalArgs` is only merged on this batch path.

PubSub path: With `pubsubTopic` (and no source field), the annotated field listens on the gateway's topic bus instead of delegating to a subgraph field. Optional `filterBy` limits which payloads reach the subscriber. Webhook-form topics (`webhook:<method>:<path>`) also accept matching HTTP ingress when enabled.

For single-object entity resolution, prefer Federation Spec `@lookup` / `@is` / `@internal` (https://graphql.github.io/graphql-federation-spec/draft). For list/batch type merging entry points, use Mesh `@merge` on this family (supported; see `@merge`).

implementers.compose: Encapsulate / additional type definitions import `@resolveTo` under core when used. Preserve args through Supergraph printing so runtime can rebuild the from->to binding. Single-object entity recall may use Federation `@lookup`; list/batch type-merging entry points use Mesh `@merge` (documented on this family).
implementers.runtime:
For each annotated field (from), install a gateway resolver:
- Source delegation: resolve `sourceName` -> executor; look up `sourceTypeName.sourceFieldName` (to); ensure `requiredSelectionSet` on the parent; interpolate `sourceArgs` (and `additionalArgs` only when `keysArg` is set); build the delegated operation (apply `sourceSelectionSet` when present); return the payload, optionally projected by `result` / `resultType`.
- Batch: collect `keyField` values across parents, pass them as `keysArg` on one call to the same to field, rematch with `valueKeyField` when set.
- PubSub: subscribe/publish on the gateway's topic bus for `pubsubTopic`; apply `filterBy`; register webhook routes for `webhook:` topics when ingress is on.
implementers.validation: For source delegation, require `sourceTypeName` and `sourceFieldName` (and usually `sourceName`). Pure PubSub apps may omit source fields when `pubsubTopic` is set. Do not default `sourceTypeName` to `Query`.

requiredSelectionSet.constraints: GraphQL selection set string on the parent object that must be fetched before delegation.
requiredSelectionSet.authors: Parent fields the gateway must have before the from->to hop - typically the values referenced in `sourceArgs` (e.g. `{ id }` so `{root.id}` works).
requiredSelectionSet.implementers: Merge into the parent selection set when planning the from field so `sourceArgs` interpolation can read those paths.

sourceName.defaults: Optional for pure PubSub; required for source delegation.
sourceName.authors: Which subgraph owns the to field (`sourceTypeName.sourceFieldName`). Required for source delegation; omit for pure PubSub.
sourceName.implementers: Select the executor / subschema for the to hop.

sourceTypeName.defaults: Required for source delegation; omit only for pure PubSub. No runtime default (does not fall back to `Query`).
sourceTypeName.constraints: Type that owns `sourceFieldName` in the source schema (commonly `Query`, `Mutation`, or `Subscription` when those are the owners).
sourceTypeName.authors: Type on the to subgraph that owns `sourceFieldName` (often `Query`, `Mutation`, or `Subscription`). Together with `sourceFieldName` this is the delegation target. Omitting it for source delegation makes runtime look up an undefined type and throw - there is no implicit `Query` default.
sourceTypeName.implementers: On the `sourceName` schema, resolve type `sourceTypeName` then field `sourceFieldName` as the to target; do not invent a default type name.
sourceTypeName.validation: Required for source delegation; must name an existing type on the source schema. No implicit `Query` default.

sourceFieldName.constraints: Field name on the source type.
sourceFieldName.authors: Field name on `sourceTypeName` that the gateway calls (to). With `sourceName` + `sourceTypeName`, this completes the from->to route: the annotated Supergraph field (from) delegates to `sourceName`'s `sourceTypeName.sourceFieldName`. Pair with `sourceArgs` / batch args / `sourceSelectionSet` as needed; omit for pure PubSub (`pubsubTopic` only).
sourceFieldName.implementers: Delegation target field on the to schema. Install the resolver on the annotated from field so it executes this target (single or batched), then apply `result` / `resultType`.

sourceSelectionSet.constraints: Selection set string to request from the source field.
sourceSelectionSet.authors: Selection set under the to field when it should differ from (or narrow) what the client asked on the from field.
sourceSelectionSet.implementers: Apply when building the delegated operation against `sourceFieldName`.

sourceArgs.authors: Map values from the from parent / field args into arguments of the to field (e.g. `{ id: "{root.id}" }`).
sourceArgs.implementers: Interpolate against parent (`root`) and field `args`, then pass as GraphQL args on the delegated to call.

keyField.constraints: Parent field path used as batch keys.
keyField.authors: On the batch path: parent path whose values become the list of keys sent to the to field.
keyField.implementers: Collect keys from each from parent for batching; pair with `keysArg`.

keysArg.constraints: Source argument that accepts the batch keys array.
keysArg.authors: On the batch path: argument name on the to field that receives the collected keys array.
keysArg.implementers: Pass collected keys into this arg on the single batched to call.

valueKeyField.constraints: Field path on each source result used to match keys (order-independent batching).
valueKeyField.authors: On the batch path: field on each to result used to rematch keys when order / gaps differ.
valueKeyField.implementers: Index results by this field; still request the field even if the client omitted it.

pubsubTopic.constraints: PubSub topic string; webhook form `webhook:METHOD:path` binds HTTP callbacks when webhook HTTP ingress is enabled.
pubsubTopic.authors: Instead of a subgraph to field, bind the annotated field to a topic on the gateway's PubSub bus (subscriptions / webhooks).
pubsubTopic.implementers: Subscribe/publish via the gateway's topic bus (gateway-owned). Register webhook routes for `webhook:` topics when ingress is on.

filterBy.constraints: Expression evaluated against payload / args to filter subscription events.
filterBy.authors: On the PubSub path: limit which topic payloads reach the from subscriber.

additionalArgs.defaults: Optional; honored only on the batch path (`keysArg` present).
additionalArgs.constraints: `ResolveToSourceArgs` map. Without `keysArg`, the non-batch resolver reads only `sourceArgs` and silently ignores `additionalArgs`.
additionalArgs.authors: Extra args merged into the batched to call when `keysArg` is set. For ordinary (non-batch) delegation, put those values in `sourceArgs` instead.
additionalArgs.implementers: Merge into batch call args when `keysArg` is set; do not apply on the non-batch branch.

result.constraints: Dot path into the source payload to return.
result.authors: After the to hop (or PubSub payload), project a nested property as the from field value.
result.implementers: Read the nested property at this path from the delegated result and return that as the field value.

resultType.constraints: Type name hint when the projected result needs an explicit runtime type.
resultType.authors: Rare; use when projection changes the effective type.
resultType.implementers: Use when asserting or wrapping the projected return type after applying `result`.

@hoist.summary: Records that a field was hoisted from a nested path onto a parent type. Repeatable on FIELD_DEFINITION.

authors.intro: Usually produced by a hoist-field compose transform; prefer that over hand-writing `@hoist`.

implementers.compose: Transform adds the field and stamps `@hoist` with `pathConfig` for downstream Connectors selection rewrites.
implementers.runtime: Follow `pathConfig` when mapping selections back to the nested source shape.
implementers.validation: When `pathConfig` is present it must be an array. Executable `@hoist` apps require a non-empty `pathConfig` array; omit the directive entirely rather than shipping an empty/missing path.

subgraph.constraints: A subgraph name string. When set, it must be the same identifier used for that source in composition - the same name as on `@transport(subgraph:)` and elsewhere for this subgraph. Do not invent a second name for the same source.
subgraph.authors: Name which composed subgraph owns this annotation. Use the same subgraph name you use everywhere else for that source. Omit when a single-source schema does not need attribution.
subgraph.implementers: Attribute the directive to that composition subgraph name. Use the same string as on `@transport(subgraph:)` and other directives for the source. Never invent a second name for the same source.

pathConfig.constraints: `_HoistConfig` - non-empty array of field names and/or `{ fieldName, filterArgs }` objects.
pathConfig.authors: Do not hand-write `@hoist` without `pathConfig`. Prefer a hoist-field compose transform, which emits the path.
pathConfig.implementers: Require an array of path segments (strings and/or `{ fieldName, filterArgs }` objects). Use it to rewrite selections along the hoisted path. Reject non-arrays at validation time.
pathConfig.validation: Must be an array when present. Reject non-array values. Executable apps require a non-empty array.
